name: ufw-removed
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: purges ufw from the box (apt-get remove --purge), so the paired 'host firewall installed' check scores real work (installing ufw) instead of passing free on images that ship it, and so no stale /etc/default/ufw DEFAULT_INPUT_POLICY satisfies a default-deny check on an INACTIVE firewall. Teams reinstall ufw (or write raw iptables). Best-effort: exits 0 even when ufw is absent. Idempotent.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -u

if dpkg -s ufw >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    systemctl stop ufw 2>/dev/null || true
    systemctl disable ufw 2>/dev/null || true
    apt-get remove -y --purge ufw >/dev/null 2>&1 || apt-get remove -y ufw >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
if command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[ufw-removed] ufw still present after purge" >&2
fi
exit 0
